title: services.services.update
description: Payload of commands/service_update.sql. `hub_id`, `current_user_id` and `now` are injected by the runtime (§2.5). What is fixed here is that an existing service cannot have its fiscal category EMPTIED: it went in knowing how it taxes and it stays that way. Deliberately minimal — the statement overwrites every column it lists, so the rest of the mandatory set (and additionalProperties) belongs to services#9.

service_id.description: Id of the service to update, of this hub.

tax_category_key.description: Canonical fiscal category the service taxes by (ADR-0085). Required so the edit cannot leave behind a service nobody can charge; `minLength` closes the "" that `required` alone lets through.

category_id.description: Service category of THIS hub, or none (services#7).

price.description: Minor units of the hub currency (ADR-0007/0123).
